prose:
Latent.Space’s AINews roundup collects reported offering results, company statements and social-media reactions to Anthropic’s first trading day. The examined opening distinguishes offering, opening, closing and after-hours prices, then turns to safety pledges, ownership and competing financial interpretations.

This is an aggregation, not independent verification of every post it cites. Paper wealth, cash burn estimates and required-return scenarios use different assumptions and should not be combined into one valuation judgment. This summary covers the examined IPO opening, not the full roundup or its other product news.
highlights: Roundup aggregates multiple kinds of sources
Different trading periods have different prices
Safety pledges are statements not measured outcomes
Paper holdings differ from realized proceeds
Later roundup topics were not examined
